_note: Regression fixture for issue #1415, reproducing PR #1413. Four inline review threads first-authored by the owner account `don-petry` with NO automation marker (i.e. maintainer findings), unresolved, postdating the last push (2026-08-02T01:00:00Z). On #1413 these were self-resolved with resolvedBy: don-petry — the agent clearing the maintainer's own review gate. The gate must BLOCK on this shape, and the resolve-guard must refuse to resolve each marker-less thread.

nodes.body: This gate's reset is reachable by the agent — resolving it here defeats the block. It must be human-gated.
Fail-open: when authorship can't be determined this returns success instead of blocking.
Login-based discrimination cannot separate the agent from the maintainer here; key on the marker.
Add a regression test that a maintainer thread never ends up resolvedBy the agent identity.
